key_points: Truist Securities lowered CHRW price target to $200 from a higher previous level.
Stock declined approximately 4% on Oct 6, though remains above recent support.
Elevated options trading activity for Oct 2026 170 strike puts and calls shows interest but no clear directional signal.
Analysts continue to list CHRW among top industrial goods picks, indicating sector confidence.
Discussion of a potential RXO acquisition/spinoff remains speculative and likely noise.
